marker_descriptor.alpha_preserving_control: First install the same RGB marker while preserving every original native alpha byte. Record whether original foliage geometry and contour stay unchanged before the full-opaque envelope marker.
marker_descriptor.orientation: u grows right; v grows down; pixel bounds are inclusive
marker_descriptor.purpose: Opaque plane outline and asymmetric static UV markers diagnose the native geometry envelope, plane width/height and translation; grayscale reduces channel/tint assumptions. Historical native CROSS_TEXTURE_POLY uses texture alpha for geometry, so the full-opaque envelope does not by itself establish original-foliage topology.
marker_descriptor.installation: Only isolated resource-pack bitmap override at the existing atlas path; preserve native block name, aux, mapping, material and geometry. Cold-load or demonstrate resource reload with explicit marker-positive pixel control; successful file write alone is insufficient.
marker_descriptor.restore: Restore original bitmap bytes and all diagnostic sources. Rebuild or cold-load the original texture and positively confirm original plant pixels before acceptance observations.

coordinate_roles.calibration: Only these four may estimate marked native plane geometry, global atlas orientation and the relation between native clip differences and visual translation. Per-cell placement is a diagnostic observation, not a universal formula.
coordinate_roles.holdout: No geometry, offset coefficients, UV mapping, camera fit or thresholds may be changed from these images. If an independently sourced hash survives calibration, publish all holdout predictions before inspecting holdout pixels. A clip lookup used at the holdout is a proposed position-query model, not a hash-prediction test.
coordinate_roles.height_repeat: Same X/Z as calibration at another Y tests the current-runtime Y-independence clue and high target Y handling.

geometry_hypotheses: Current native planes have constant shape/UV and per-cell translation; marker observations can reject this without using foliage texture centroids.
Differences of native clips between two cells equal differences of native visual translation for poppy, after one constant default-shape bias. Absolute bbox centroid=.5 remains unproven.
Native mesh at destination is determined by destination logical world X/Z and possibly Y, not capture origin or context/overlay encoded coordinates.
observation_order: Independent same-session stone camera calibration and native original-texture poppy baseline.
Install isolated marker; freeze marker source and verify visible marker positive control.

Capture alpha-preserving marker positive control, freeze actual graphics mode, then capture full-opaque envelope marker at four calibration cells in two independently calibrated views; save native clip and actual states as ancillary observations. Reject the fixed-plane assumption if texture alpha changes route/topology in an unexplained way.
Publish fixed geometry hypothesis and any hash predictions, then capture marker holdouts plus Yrepeat.
Restore original bitmap and positively establish original-texture rendering.
Use untouched original textures and independent native references for dry+h0 at holdout coordinates; editor/full/missing verdicts remain separate.
Extend remaining snow heights only after dry+h0 pass; preserve failures and restoration receipts.
efficient_relocation_controls: Keep the same frozen document while changing render origin A to B to A; expected placement is a function of destination, with no stale geometry/cache reuse.
Capture identical block/state documents at distinct source origins, render both at B, and require the same destination placement.
One document with identical poppies at several logical cells, including a 16-cell chunk boundary and snow background layers, catches identity-only cache errors.
Use logical target cell before overlay/context packing, then independently check packed and unpacked paths at the same world cell.
